classification: short model-backed serial inference smoke; not a performance benchmark or parity test

build.cmake: -G Ninja -DSTRATA_HIP_GFX906=ON -DCMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=gfx906 -DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON, clang/clang++ from the ROCm LLVM

distribution.run_from: native build on the host with the merge tree's Python server; no container

environment.hardware_class: one AMD Instinct MI50 32 GB, gfx906 (HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0); an integrated wave32 GPU was hidden
environment.model_assets: external Qwen3.8 Flash-Next IQ3_S assets with a pack built by the v0.1.41 tools; not distributed
environment.expert_cache: auto (13590 slots, 25.79 GiB VRAM) with data/expert-profile.bin
environment.speculation: --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5 with the MTP draft layer; --batch-mtp configured but reported off (needs --batch 2 or more)
environment.scheduler: serial; no --batch, no --pipeline-windows; AB/CD not present

requests.note: the 3 of 6 difference is the two suffix-lookup windows, which the trace excludes from MTP counts by design

limitations: Two short greedy requests on one card; the run does not establish sustained throughput, batching, AB/CD, layer-split, or two-card behavior.
The engine warned that 459 MiB of VRAM was free at the second request (below its 512 MiB guidance); the run completed, but a larger --vram-reserve-mib is advised for longer runs at this cache size.
Identical greedy output with traces on and off shows the trace does not perturb this run; it is not token parity against the archived image or another build.
The watchdog release path and the overlapped split's hand-off flag were not exercised: no window timed out and no split was configured.
